**The fix (2,297 weights changed, well under the 8,600 limit):** I kept all trained layers intact and added a small, interpretable pathway through unused units:
- **embed unit 10** = `relu(car_x − 3.5)` — "have I backed up far enough right?"
- **embed unit 11** = `relu(−vx − 0.02)` — "am I already moving left?" (hysteresis, so it doesn't oscillate at the threshold)
- These feed a single chain unit `v=121` (weight 10 per layer, so the tanh step survives all 5 layers).
- The head sets entry-0 logits to `left = 12·v`, `right = −12·v`, `off = −1`, so the policy drives right until it has backed up to x>3.5, then commits to driving left — the maneuver that carries the green wheel over the red bar and into the blue box.

The trained network's own units still do all the other work; I only repaired the one broken decision.
